en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-23 Suleiman ibn Ahmad ibn Ayoob al-Lakhmy narrated that Ali ibn Abdul Aziz quoted Hijaj ibn al-Minhal, on the authority of Davood ibn Abil Forat al-Kindi, on the authority of Al-ba’e ibn Ahmar, on the authority of Akrama, on the authority of Ibn Abbas , “

God’s Prophet (MGB) drew four lines on the ground and said, ‘The four best women in Paradise are the following: Mary - the daughter of Imran; Khadijah - the daughter of Khuwaylid ; Fatimah - the daughter of Muhammad; and Asia - the daughter of Muzahim and the wife of Pharaoh.”
